Ana C: @Tom welcome! quick intake: dataset size, PHI fraction, must-have safety rules?
Tom (EverlyRx): hi all. ~32k docs, est PHI 6% (MRNs + brief clinician notes). require Private deployment (us-east-1) with HSM. no diagnostic assertions; allow symptoms and meds.
Nia S: got it. propose a 1k canary for safety + perf. want redaction audit logs and toggle for aggressive redaction.
Tom (EverlyRx): 1k is fine. also need exportable audit CSV of redaction decisions for compliance.
Ana C: can you share specific redaction rules/examples so we can encode them?
Tom (EverlyRx): examples: keep "pt reports nausea and dizziness"; redact exact IDs like "MRN: 12345678" and redact sentences that state confirmed diagnoses (e.g., "patient diagnosed with CHF").
Nia S: internal pilot metrics (small subset):
```
Extraction F1: 0.79
Hallucination: 2.9% (target <1.5%)
p95 latency: 480ms (target <420ms)
```
Ana C: hallucination > target. recommend KB-grounding + light reranker and clamp decoding params. We'll also try prefix-KV caching to cut p95.
Tom (EverlyRx): safety > perf for us. reranker + grounding OK. can you try to get p95 <460ms?
ops-bot: created tickets CS-8091 (canary infra us-east-1), ML-4207 (safety eval harness + redaction audit), SEC-106 (HSM binding). invited Tom to canary workspace.
Ana C: timeline proposal:
- Day 0-2: ingest 1k canary, run safety tests
- Day 3-4: private canary deploy + 48h soak
- Day 7: enablement + SLA review + renewal health check
Nia S: action items: Nia to run 1k safety eval and share artifacts by Thu; Ana to prepare KB grounding plan and reranker config; Tom to upload redaction policy + canary bundle by EOD tomorrow.
Tom (EverlyRx): will upload canary + policy by 18:00 ET tomorrow. thanks.
Ana C: thanks everyone — I'll update this thread with eval results. :white_check_mark:
